description: History of automated and manual remediation actions taken on anomaly detection jobs (from the ml-remediation-log index): action, outcome, before-state, linked case. Use before acting on a job to see what was already tried and whether the loop guard (3 auto-fixes per 24h) is in effect. Pass job_id '*' for all jobs.

configuration.query: FROM ml-remediation-log | WHERE ?job_id == "*" OR job_id == ?job_id | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 7 days | SORT @timestamp DESC | KEEP @timestamp, job_id, action, outcome, issue, source, query_delay_before, query_delay_after, case_id, execution_id | LIMIT 50

job_id.description: Anomaly detection job ID, or * for all jobs
